{{Quote|Star Tours! What are you doing here? This is a combat zone. It's restricted... ease off on your main thruster.|Red Leader|<ref name="ST" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] '''Red Leader'''<ref name="ILM book">
{{BookCite|author=Vaz, Mark Cotta|container=|title=Industrial Light & Magic : into the digital realm|publisher=Del Rey|date=1996|link=https://archive.org/details/industriallightm0000vazm}}</ref> was an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who commanded the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] [[Red Squadron (Star Tours)|Red Squadron]] during a [[Battle of Death Star III|battle]] with forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] over what appeared to be a [[Death Star III|third]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="Convenient" />

When the [[Star Tours Flight 45]], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droid]] [[RX-24/Legends|RX-24]], arrived in the midst of the battle in a [[StarSpeeder 3000]], the New Republic pilot identified the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] as belonging to the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency and chastised the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for straying into a restricted area. Eventually, Red Squadron reached the battlestation's [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] and fired a salvo of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]] into it, thus destroying the planetoid.<ref name="ST" />

Unbeknownst to Red Leader and the rest of the Alliance, the purported "Death Star III" was a [[worldcraft]] that had been modified by the self-proclaimed Imperial [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Ennix Devian]] to resemble one of the Death Stars. The battle's aim was keeping the Alliance occupied while Devian's [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissension]] forces stole [[Warship/Legends|warships]] from the Alliance's shipyards in neighboring [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="Warlords2" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Steve_Gawley-SWI_43.jpg|250px|thumb|Steve Gawley behind the scenes as Red Leader]]
Red Leader was played by [[Steve Gawley]] ([[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM's]] model shop supervisor for the attraction) on the onboard video screen inside the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] simulator.<ref name="ILM book">
{{BookCite|author=Vaz, Mark Cotta|container=|title=Industrial Light & Magic : into the digital realm|publisher=Del Rey|date=1996|link=https://archive.org/details/industriallightm0000vazm}}</ref> The helmet he wears appears to be the same as [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Porkins]]' from {{Film|IV}}, matching the photo of the worn helmet prop in the ''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]'' book.<ref name="Costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref> [[Kasan Moor/Legends|Kasan Moor]], pilot from the ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron]]'' video game, also wears the same helmet.<ref name="RS">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>
